findings.location: Sidebar disclaimer and question text in 'My Cart' ('* Any applicable taxes...', 'Questions? Please direct...')
findings.issue: The light grey body text and secondary links on the white background in the right-hand sidebar fail to meet the WCAG AA minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1.
findings.recommendation: Change the text color of the disclaimer and question text to a darker grey (minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 against the white background) to ensure readability for users with low vision.

findings.location: Grey background box text ('IEEE member', 'IEEE Student member', 'Non-IEEE member' and prices)
findings.issue: The text inside the grey pricing box uses a medium grey font color against a light grey background block, failing the WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast requirement.
findings.recommendation: Increase the text color darkness to at least #595959 or darker, or darken the text to black/dark blue to guarantee a safe contrast ratio against the grey background container.

findings.issue: The arrow/chevron separators in the 'Contact Information > Profile Summary > Catalog > ...' horizontal progression bar are vertically misaligned (positioned too low) relative to the neighboring text labels.
findings.recommendation: Adjust the vertical alignment of the chevron icons using CSS (e.g., flexbox alignment or vertical-align adjustments) so that they are optically centered with the text labels.

findings.issue: Inconsistent button styling and border-radius applications are used across the interface: the orange Search button has sharp left corners and rounded right corners, while the orange 'CONTINUE' button is a fully rounded capsule shape.
findings.recommendation: Standardize the button component design system. Apply consistent border-radius (e.g., 4px or capsule) across all primary interactive button elements.
